description: Electricity Maps publishes a collection of parsers that collect and standardise electricity production, cross-border exchanges and price data. The code uses public sources, including government agencies and transmission system operators, and feeds the separate Electricity Maps service. Inputs are source-specific electricity feeds; outputs are harmonised operational observations for supported regions. Coverage is international, with resolution and history depending on each upstream provider. Current source is free under AGPL-3.0; early contributions used MIT. A limitation is that parser availability and source changes affect coverage, and this code licence does not establish unrestricted access to the commercial service or all historical data. The parsers can prepare observed supply and exchange series for power-network simulations. SustainCluster (model-sustaincluster) is a related model that names Electricity Maps as an external input. It does not describe this parser collection. No electricity feed or data archive was downloaded.
name: Electricity Maps electricity data parsers
